While your main focus will be at the Front Office, you will also gain valuable exposure within our Food & Beverage outlets, allowing you to develop a well-rounded understanding of hotel operations.The internship starts in February 2027 and offers a full-time learning experience aligned with your study requirementsResponsibilities• Communicate effectively with colleagues and guests, contributing to a positive team environment and consistent service delivery• Support the guest journey, including check-ins, check-outs, and handling guest requests across phone, written, and face-to-face communication• Assist with reservations, payments, and front office administrative tasks• Gain hands-on experience within Food & Beverage operations, supporting service where needed• Maintain a professional and welcoming environment in both Front Office and F&B areas in line with brand standards• Collaborate with departments such as housekeeping and food and beverage to ensure smooth daily operationsEssential Requirements• Currently enrolled in a hospitality or related study programme• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)• Proactive attitude with willingness to learn and develop across departments• Guest-focused mindset with a positive and professional approach• Enjoys working in a team and adapting to different operational environments• Available for

jobs.occupation: Front Office Host(ess) - Park Plaza Eindhoven
jobs.description: Feel the authentic. Park Plaza Eindhoven offers 104 stylish rooms and suites in the heart of the City of Light, within walking distance of Central Station, Van Abbemuseum, and Strijp, the hotel is ideal for business trips and weekend escapes.As a Front Office Host(ess), you will ensure guests feel welcome and cared for throughout their stay by delivering warm, attentive service at every interaction. The position manages arrivals, departures, and guest requests while maintaining a well-organised front desk environment and plays a key part in ensuring guest satisfaction, operational efficiency, and adherence to service standards, while also supporting cross-departmental collaboration when needed.Responsibilities• Communicate effectively with colleagues and guests, contributing to a positive team environment and consistent service delivery• Manage the guest journey, including check-ins, check-outs, and all guest requests across phone, written, and face-to-face communication• Handle reservations, payments, and front office administrative tasks accurately• Maintain a professional and welcoming front desk environment in line with brand standards• Collaborate with other departments such as housekeeping and food and beverage to ensure smooth daily operationsEssential Requirements• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)• Ability to remain calm and organised in a fast-paced environment• Good level of accuracy and attention to detail• Guest-focused mindset with a proactive and responsible approach• Eligible to work in the NetherlandsPreferred Requirements• Experience in Front Office or guest-facing hospitality roles• Familiarity with hotel systems (PMS)• Knowledge of Eindhoven or willingness to develop local expertise• Dutch or any additional language skills; is an advantage• Experience handling guest requests and service recoveryYour Benefits & Perks• Discounted hotel stays across the Radisson Hotel Group world
